narrative.intro: C J Mahan Construction obligated $215M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date across 12 awards, with an average award size of $17.9M. Obligations rose up 247.4% year over year. Fiscal-year obligations show a multi-year presence: FY21 $66.4M, FY22 $7.2M, FY23 $24.1M, FY24 $52.9M, and FY25 $61.9M, leading into the FY26 total. The firm's work is concentrated in heavy civil construction: Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction accounts for $212M of FY2026 to date obligations. Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction accounts for $3M, and Ship Building and Repairing accounts for $204K. Current-year totals are partial, reflecting fiscal year to date obligations rather than full-year totals. The figures above are contract obligations except award-value figures in largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which would be total contract values. This profile shows a heavy civil construction focus and a sharp year-over-year increase in obligations for FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: What work does C J Mahan Construction primarily deliver to the government?
sections.body: C J Mahan Construction delivers heavy civil construction work, as shown by $212M in Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction obligations for FY2026 to date. The firm also delivers water and sewer projects with $3M in obligations and limited ship repair work with $204K in obligations.
